name: Lucid
subtitle: Offline video enhancement · Beta
localizedDescription: FIRST BETA. Restore video detail at its original resolution or upscale 2x/4x with bundled Real-ESRGAN. Native pastel pink-purple SwiftUI and Liquid Glass controls, adjustable strength, a 2-second preview, original audio preservation, pause/cancel, thermal safeguards, and a private local export library. RIFE 30/60 FPS motion interpolation is implemented and bundled in the iPhone build, but its two GPU tests require physical-device testing and are explicitly not reported as passed. Eleven other simulator tests cover restoration, exports, audio timing, orientation, cancellation and error handling. No accounts, uploads, analytics or model downloads. Standard-color SDR input only; up to 4K output and 1080p input for motion. H.264 MOV exports; originals stay untouched. Physical iPhone performance, heat, LiveContainer compatibility and long-export reliability remain unverified.
